education.faculty_dept_en: Faculty of Engineering — Computer Engineering Major
education.description_id: Menempuh pendidikan sarjana Teknik Komputer dengan pendalaman pada arsitektur sistem cerdas, kecerdasan buatan terapan (computer vision), struktur data, algoritma, serta pengembangan perangkat lunak terintegrasi.
education.description_en: Pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Engineering with a focus on intelligent system architectures, applied artificial intelligence (computer vision), data structures, algorithms, and integrated software development.

projects.description_id: Mengembangkan model deteksi objek untuk mengidentifikasi penyakit pada tumbuhan dan manusia menggunakan framework YOLO dengan hasil evaluasi di atas 90%. Dilengkapi arsitektur CNN deep learning dan pipeline image processing komprehensif.
projects.description_en: Developed an object detection model to identify diseases in plants and humans using the YOLO framework with evaluation results exceeding 90%. Features deep learning CNN architecture and a comprehensive image processing pipeline.

projects.description_id: Arsitektur backend sistem informasi desa wisata SIBARISTA menggunakan NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, dan PostgreSQL (Neon). Dilengkapi autentikasi JWT & RBAC, Public API pagination, dan integrasi Cloudinary.
projects.description_en: Backend architecture for the SIBARISTA tourism village information system using NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL (Neon). Equipped with JWT & RBAC authentication, paginated Public API, and Cloudinary integration.

projects.description_id: Aplikasi web untuk enkripsi dan dekripsi teks dengan lima cipher klasik: Hill 2×2, Vigenère, Playfair, Affine, dan Caesar. Dilengkapi validasi matriks kunci Hill (determinan dan invers modular), riwayat sesi yang bisa dicari, serta ekspor/impor JSON.
projects.description_en: Web application for encrypting and decrypting text with five classical ciphers: Hill 2×2, Vigenère, Playfair, Affine, and Caesar. Features Hill key matrix validation (determinant and modular inverse), searchable session history, and JSON export/import.

projects.description_id: Digital portfolio dan aplikasi To-Do List otomatis yang dikembangkan dengan Python lalu dikonversi menjadi aplikasi web responsif modern menggunakan framework JavaScript, React/Next.js, dan Tailwind CSS.
projects.description_en: Personal digital portfolio and automated To-Do list app, developed in Python and converted into modern responsive web applications using JavaScript, React/Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

projects.description_id: Aplikasi pelacak pengeluaran otomatis dan perkakas produktivitas berbasis Python untuk pembukuan terstruktur dan penganggaran keuangan pribadi.
projects.description_en: Automated expense tracker and Python-based productivity tools for structured bookkeeping and personal financial budgeting.

experience.description_id: Mengembangkan arsitektur backend sistem informasi desa wisata SIBARISTA menggunakan NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, dan PostgreSQL (Neon). Mengimplementasikan sistem autentikasi JWT dan Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), menyusun Public API dengan pagination, serta membangun UploadService menggunakan Cloudinary untuk manajemen aset media.
experience.description_en: Developed backend architecture for the SIBARISTA tourism village information system using NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL (Neon). Implemented JWT authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), structured paginated Public APIs, and built UploadService using Cloudinary for media asset management.

experience.description_id: Merumuskan Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP) anggaran serta terlibat dalam penyusunan alokasi dana untuk mendukung pengelolaan yang transparan dan akuntabel.
experience.description_en: Formulated budget Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and participated in fund allocation planning to support transparent and accountable student governance.

experience.description_id: Merancang dan mengeksekusi strategi visual media sosial untuk meningkatkan interaksi pengikut dan memperkuat identitas digital organisasi.
experience.description_en: Designed and executed social media visual strategies to enhance audience engagement and strengthen the organization's digital brand identity.

experience.description_id: Mengoordinasikan kebutuhan infrastruktur panggung dan tata letak teknis untuk kegiatan tingkat fakultas yang dihadiri ratusan peserta.
experience.description_en: Coordinated stage infrastructure and technical layout requirements for faculty-level activities attended by hundreds of participants.
